lines.zh: 我浮在花丛上方，慢慢飘。
lines.en: I float above the flowers, drifting slowly.
Petal brushes my tail. Lightly.
I travel suspended, feet never touching.
From this field of flowers to that one.

lines.zh: 我从向日葵中间穿过去。
lines.en: I weave between the sunflowers.

lines.zh: 翅膀扇得很慢，几乎没声。
lines.en: Slow wingbeats. Almost silent.
I fly at the height of the blossoms.
Dew on them. I don't touch it.

lines.zh: 我绕着一株花转了半圈。
lines.en: I circle one flower half a turn.
I head where the flowers are thicker.
The wind lifts me a little.
I descend slowly.
I rest on a stem, wings folded.

lines.zh: 这身颜色，像花的一部分。
lines.en: This color of mine looks like part of the flower.

lines.zh: 花蜜的味道，从下面上来。
lines.en: The smell of nectar rises from below.
Still like this, nothing picks me out.
My tail curls slowly.
Sun makes the petals translucent.

lines.zh: 我在等一个够大的东西。
lines.en: I'm waiting for something big enough.
Bees are busy. Not my concern.
This face of mine, hidden in the blooms.
I lift a foreleg and groom my wing.
The field is too big. I can't cover it all.
It's pleasant here. I'd like to stay.
What I'm waiting for always comes.
The wind turned. I smell it.
I turn my head slowly.
Nectar drips. I don't go for it.
The sun isn't high yet; I wait.
A while more. No rush.
You've walked into the field.
I won't strike right away.
I want to watch you a little more.

lines.zh: 你比向日葵还高，我记下了。
lines.en: Taller than a sunflower — noted.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，你也没发现。
lines.en: I haven't moved. Neither have you noticed.
You're bending down.
You stand among flowers — perfect.
My wings open a little.
Petals behind you.

lines.zh: 你抬头的角度，我算过了。
lines.en: I've worked out the angle you'll lift your head.

lines.zh: 从这朵花到那朵，都归我。
lines.en: From this flower to that one — all mine.
Pick flowers if you like. I won't stop you.
A tear in my wing.
I drop into the flowers and hide.
I'll just fly slower.
Petals stained with my blood.
I pull back behind the stem.
Don't touch my tail.
I can still fly. Just crooked.
That has made me wary.
In this field I can hide.
My blood is on the petals.
Nectar. I have plenty.
Holding out a flower. Thoughtful.
I settle on the petal and test it.
This one's overblown.
Something fresher.
Keep your hand still. I'll come look.

lines.zh: 我顺着花茎，一点点爬近。
lines.en: I crawl down the stem, inch by inch.
This one's not bad.
But that isn't what I want.
Leave it. I'll wait for other things.

lines.zh: 你撞到了花梗，我晃了一下。
lines.en: You knocked the stem. I swayed.
I pull back and vanish into the bloom.
Don't touch. Then I'd have to move.
This close, and you still don't see me.
Your sleeve swept past.
I press to the inside of the petal.

lines.zh: 这一下，打乱了我的位置。
lines.en: That spoiled my position.

lines.zh: 我重新找一朵花落下去。
lines.en: I find another flower and settle.
If you'd only come a little nearer.
Just a little closer is enough.
Not many of my kind in this field.
Are you hidden in flowers too?
We rest side by side on a petal.
Your color differs from mine.
You say nothing. That's fine too.
Our wings are nearly as thin.
When this season passes.
Flowers fade. We're in no hurry.
Let's wait for the next blooms.
Fly a little higher. I'll watch.
I settle on it and test it.

lines.zh: 花丛里这么重，我提不动。
lines.en: So heavy in the flowers. I cannot lift it.
I'll take this petal.
I drag it into the flower's heart.
Yours. I won't take it.

lines.zh: 我的花粉，落在你衣领上。
lines.en: My pollen settles on your collar.
I only pick the sweet ones.
It's stuck to my leg.
I tuck it under the blossom.

lines.zh: 我藏在花里，花粉就是我的毒。
lines.en: I hide in blooms; pollen is my venom.
You've come into the middle of the field.
I've adjusted my position.
Your back is to my flower.
I open my wings a little.
You're warm; my flowers like that.

lines.zh: 这股温度，我很久没碰过。
lines.en: I haven't touched that in a long while.
Where you stand — the distance is right.
My wings open. Starting.
You won't hear it.
The flowers muffle my sound.
Inch by inch, the petals arrive first.
Still picking flowers.
Petals hide my wings.
I hover behind your shoulder.
You haven't turned.
You haven't turned. Very good.

lines.zh: 我的尾尖，离你已经很近了。
lines.en: The tip of my tail is very close now.
One second more. Just one.
I never wait long.
These flowers will cover the sound.
The tail barb goes in. Quick.
I withdraw behind the flowers.
Where you touch will go numb.
I hover and watch you.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，可会拖很久。
lines.en: It isn't heavy, but it lingers.
Pollen in your eyes makes you stagger.
In a flower field you can't run fast.

lines.zh: 花瓣一合，我贴到你身边。
lines.en: My petals close and I press to your side.
My thorn is already at your back.
When you fall, the flowers will cover you.
I rise out of a blossom.

lines.zh: 花田很大，我有很多地方可待。
lines.en: The field is large. I've many places to wait.

lines.zh: 我从花里钻出来，翅还湿。
lines.en: I crawl from a flower, wings still wet.

lines.zh: 我先停在最高的那朵上。
lines.en: I settle on the tallest flower first.
From here I can see far.
Nectar on the wind.

lines.zh: 这片花田，以前也有过我。
lines.en: This field has had me in it before.

lines.zh: 我的颜色，是照着花来的。
lines.en: My color was taken from the flowers.
Someone's walking along the edge.
No hurry. I'll watch first.
He'll come in eventually.
The flowers will hold him.
Fire passed and my wings curled.

lines.zh: 我从花上掉下去，摔在土里。
lines.en: I fell from the flower onto the soil.

lines.zh: 水粘住我的翅，我沉下去。
lines.en: Water glues my wings and I sink.

lines.zh: 气流把花瓣和我一起吹散。
lines.en: The blast scattered petals and me together.
Something went through my wing.
That light bleached my color.
The flowers are gone. I grow weak.

lines.zh: 雷一落，我的花瓣全焦了。
lines.en: Lightning falls and my petals scorch.

lines.zh: 繁花森林里，我反而显眼。
lines.en: In the flower forest, I stand out.
